title: Continuity of the segment integral of a continuous operator field
statement: Let n, l >= 0, let g : R^n -> L(R^n, R^l), and let U ⊆ R^n be open and convex with g continuous on U. Then the map I : R^n x R^n -> R^l, I(a, b) := integral_0^1 g(a + tau(b - a))(b - a) dtau, is continuous on U x U (product topology).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (g : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → ContinuousOn g U → ContinuousOn (fun p : Rn n × Rn n => ∫ τ in (0:ℝ)..1, g (p.1 + τ • (p.2 - p.1)) (p.2 - p.1)) (U ×ˢ U)
